lesson.title: Kubernetes from Zero, part 19: Ingress and Gateway API basics
lesson.description: Route HTTP into a kind cluster by host, path and header: an Ingress with its controller, then the same routes as a Gateway API HTTPRoute.
lesson.tested: Ingress and HTTPRoute via Traefik v3.7.17, Gateway API v1.6.3, kind v0.33.0, node v1.37.0, 10 Nov 2026
lesson.rule: An Ingress or HTTPRoute is only a rule; a controller makes it real. New work should start on Gateway API, where the Gateway owner decides which namespaces may attach routes.

cheatsheet.intro: Host, path and header routing, and the commands from Lesson 19.

rows.name: Ingress
rows.role: A stored HTTP rule: host, path, Service and port. Nothing happens until an Ingress controller is running. The API is frozen.

rows.name: Ingress NGINX
rows.role: Retired on 24 March 2026. Existing installs keep running. It gets no further releases.

rows.name: GatewayClass
rows.role: Names the controller. The lab used Traefik v3.7.17, which serves both Ingress and Gateway API.

rows.name: Gateway
rows.role: Listeners and allowedRoutes. The default for allowedRoutes is from: Same, so only routes in the Gateway's namespace attach.

rows.name: HTTPRoute
rows.role: The app's matches and backends. The most specific match wins, and a longer path prefix beats a header match.

rows.name: No controller
rows.role: Creating an Ingress has no effect. An Ingress named legacy with class nginx was ignored and returned 404 until the class was patched to traefik.
No rule matched, or the class has no running controller.
A rule matched but the backend is invalid, such as a Service port that does not exist.

rows.name: Accepted=False
rows.role: The Gateway refused the route. The lab saw NotAllowedByListeners when allowedRoutes was left at Same.

items.what: Host shop.example.test sent /api to api and / to web, once the traefik class was served.
/ with x-version beta went to web-beta. /api with the same header still went to api, because the longer path prefix wins.
A request for a host no rule names returned 404.
Gateway API CRDs came from the v1.6.3 standard-install.yaml, applied with server-side apply.

commands.note: the retirement check; the lab returned nothing
a rule, until a controller exists
CLASS must name a running controller

commands.cmd: kubectl exec -n k8s-from-zero client -- curl -s -H "Host: shop.example.test" http://traefik.traefik/

homework.intro: Use the kind cluster from part 3 and the namespace k8s-from-zero. The lesson installed Traefik v3.7.17 and Gateway API v1.6.3. Answers are in the separate answer key.

sections.title: Recall
sections.hint: Answer from memory, then check the lesson.

exercises.q: What happens if you create an Ingress and no controller is running?
exercises.a: Nothing. Kubernetes stores the object. A controller Deployment watches Ingress objects and configures a proxy. Without it, requests are not routed.

exercises.q: What is the default allowedRoutes on a Gateway listener, and why does it matter?
exercises.a: from: Same. Only HTTPRoutes in the Gateway's own namespace can attach. A route in another namespace is refused until the listener allows it.

exercises.q: When a request carries x-version: beta and the path is /api, which backend wins in the lesson?
exercises.a: api. Path length is compared before headers, and /api is a longer prefix than /. The header match sends / to web-beta only when no longer path wins.

exercises.q: Run the ingress-nginx detection command from the lesson. What did the lab record, and what does an empty result mean?
exercises.a: It returned nothing. This cluster is not running the retired Ingress NGINX controller. Ingress NGINX was retired on 24 March 2026.

exercises.q: Create an Ingress with ingressClassName nginx, request its host, then patch the class to traefik. What status codes did the lesson see?
exercises.a: 404 while the class had no controller. After the patch to traefik, the same request returned hello from web within a few seconds.

exercises.q: Read the HTTPRoute status after you remove allowedRoutes from the Gateway. Which condition did the lesson record?
exercises.a: Accepted=False, reason NotAllowedByListeners, because the default from: Same refuses a route in k8s-from-zero when the Gateway is in another namespace.

sections.title: Predict the outcome
sections.hint: Write your prediction first. Then check the answer key.

exercises.q: The Ingress exists and every request gets 404. What does the lesson tell you to check?
exercises.a: kubectl get ingress. CLASS must name an IngressClass whose controller is running. A leftover nginx class or nginx annotation is a common cause.

exercises.q: A matching rule returns 500. What does the lesson name as the cause?
exercises.a: The backend is invalid, for example a Service port that does not exist. Route status shows ResolvedRefs=False.

exercises.q: You are starting a new HTTP route. Which API does the lesson say to use?
exercises.a: Gateway API. The Ingress API stays available and will not be removed, and it will get no further changes. The project recommends Gateway.
